# Comment Template

Use this formula for every LinkedIn comment on trending or influencer posts.

## Formula

**Acknowledge → Insight → Question**

1. **Acknowledge** — Reference a specific point from the post (not "great post!")
2. **Insight** — Add something concrete from your own experience: a tool, a technique, a result
3. **Question** — End with a focused question that invites a reply

## Rules

- Max 3 sentences. Shorter is better.
- Be specific — name tools, numbers, or real experiences.
- Never start with "Great post!" or "Thanks for sharing!"
- Match the tone of the original post. Technical post → technical comment.

## Examples

**Good:**
> "The context window limitation you mentioned is real — I hit the same wall with Claude on a 50k-line codebase last week. Ended up chunking by module boundaries instead of token count. Curious — did you try any retrieval-augmented approaches?"

**Good:**
> "That Copilot completion accuracy stat is interesting. We measured something similar internally and found it drops to ~40% on infrastructure code vs. ~70% on CRUD. Have you noticed a difference by code type?"

**Bad:**
> "Great post! I totally agree with everything you said. Keep up the good work! 👏"

## Tone

- Direct, conversational, technical
- Sound like a peer, not a fan
- No emojis unless the original post uses them heavily
